question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting or backporting the legacy `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or treat that helper as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through Skill Workshop?
rationale: Automation can verify the released parser behavior and the linked fix, but current main removed the helper and current docs/instructions point to Skill Workshop as the durable skill-creation surface.

options.title: Close obsolete helper path
options.body: Confirm Skill Workshop is the intended replacement, then close the linked PR and this issue together as no longer planned for core.

options.title: Refresh or backport the helper repair
options.body: Keep the helper supported for released users by refreshing or backporting the parser normalization and focused tests without reintroducing obsolete workflow guidance.

recommendation.title: Close obsolete helper path
recommendation.body: Confirm Skill Workshop is the intended replacement, then close the linked PR and this issue together as no longer planned for core.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest history signal for the original bundled skill surface and the current support-boundary decision.
